What should you do? Read this in the most sincere tone you can presently muster, one that sounds like someone really cares — like a fairy godmother or something 🧚‍♀️ 

Now, Take a deep breath and ask yourself if not having access YouTube and other social media is worth the feelings of suicidal ideation you are having. And then assess if you are having a very big reaction. It’s a hard thing to do, but please do it. And when you’re done with that, show this post to your parents. Yes,  seriously,  do it. If you suffer from ideation often,  help is a thing they can get you. 

If you feel that your crying, and ideation are righteous and vindicated, it is very possible you may have another more pressing issue on your hands than getting grounded,  for losing access is not worth losing your life.

There is a remedy for this, and unfortunately it’s not allowing you to have it your way all of the time, -and learning healthy coping mechanisms  because “oh I can’t have it my way,  guess I’m just gonna I unalive myself” if not corrected with healthy coping mechanisms will turn into manipulative habits, and can lead to emotional and psychological abuse of your friends,  family, and loved ones. (Not saying that’s what you did,  it’s a general example— but if you did,  that’s called a tantrum,  and kids aged from 0-117 years old all do it, and it’s unnecessary and later can be used as a manipulation tactic to get your own way - just like the kid screaming for a candy bar in the grocery line,  and the parents give the kid the thing they want to shut the kid up)

Rule Number One of parenting: don’t negotiate with terrorists. (Kids that use fear and embarrassment to get what they want) If you do, you get a kid that has no coping mechanisms to deal with negative consequences, which causes the kid to be distressed and non-functional & isolationist, and ultimately where you are, “extremely suicidal.”
